## Lecture outline (draft)

The explicit scheme and its stability condition, the implicit scheme and tridiagonal solver, Crank–Nicolson. Comparison with the Green function; inhomogeneous and nonlinear media; the random walk as the microscopic picture.

- **Problem:** Cooling of a rod and spreading of heat. The reference is the Green function and Fourier series; nonlinear conduction and inhomogeneous media have no analytic solution.
- **Tools:** von Neumann stability analysis, implicit schemes, the tridiagonal (Thomas) algorithm, the method of lines, stiff systems.
